title: Kissed Buttery Venezuelan Rice Pilaf
description: A macrobiotic friendly one pot dish featuring oyster sauce and ferment kimchi, cooked to perfection in a mason jar. This Venezuelan rice pilaf is buttery and shaggy, with a unique blend of flavors.
instructions: Rinse the rice in a fine mesh strainer until the water runs clear.
Combine the rice, oyster sauce, ferment kimchi, butter, water, salt, and black pepper in a large mason jar.
Stir the mixture until the butter is fully incorporated and the rice is well coated.
Cover the mason jar with a lid and place it over medium heat.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 18 minutes.
Remove the mason jar from the heat and let it cool for 5 minutes.
Fluff the rice pilaf with a fork and stir in the chopped scallions.
Serve the kissed buttery Venezuelan rice pilaf hot, garnished with additional scallions if desired.
